svg.text: [view] problemStatementAIView : ProblemStatementAIView — Delivery Drone Problem Statement

g.text: How can we deliver small packages to remote places faster and at lower cost than today's ground-based delivery,
using our existing electric delivery drone platform? The current drones must return to a ground dock to recharge,
which limits their range and makes remote deliveries slow and expensive.
Project owner: John Finch, head of drone engineering at the contractor and accountable for the project.
Brownfield system: the existing delivery drone system (deliveryDroneSystemImpl), a fleet of drones,
a control station, and docks where the drones are charged.
